comparison.localAssembly: checkpoint/dist compiled leaf; same local fixture UI rendered inside PageRouter iframe
comparison.scope: Full discoverable public frontend parity, excluding backend/live-service outcomes. Current C6 local implementation is intentionally narrower; auth-role screens were not observed.

candidates.observation: Live reference uses green global header, public Home/Donate/Sign Up/About/Contact/Partners navigation, dark navy site canvas, chalkboard hero and public donor/teacher cards. Local preview is a synthetic teacher-journey screen with a demo banner, step rail, controls, and a three-link Register/Teachers/Log in header; integrated route adds PageRouter chrome and frames the leaf at a reduced viewport.
candidates.scopeNote: Confirm intended parity target with local product/source inventory; local app may intentionally be a functional synthetic journey, not a full marketing-site clone.

candidates.observation: Reference has distinct Home, About/team, Partners, Contact, Forgot Password and public teacher-profile pages. Captured local leaf exposes Register, Teachers, and Log in plus fixture-driven journey/profile states. The captured surface does not demonstrate the marketing, partner, contact, reset, or featured-profile page shells.
candidates.scopeNote: Candidate from observed route coverage, not a claim that these pages are required in the synthetic demo; source inventory should establish intended product scope.

candidates.observation: Both sides expose a directory and profile concept. Live public teacher profile includes photo/hero, school/location, biography, wishlist and share affordances. Local directory/profile screenshots show fixture records and demo-local profile flow; content, layout, affordances and navigation are not a demonstrated match.
candidates.scopeNote: Compare intended public-display requirements against source inventory. Wishlist destination/transactions excluded.

candidates.observation: Both show teacher registration and school geography. Live shell asks for password and confirmation and opens a Terms and Conditions dialog. Local shell uses fixed demo identity, passwordless demo semantics, synthetic selectors, consent and a preview journey; its visible terms/consent presentation differs.
candidates.scopeNote: Live form was not submitted. Local fixture submission and simulated approval are not production auth parity.

candidates.observation: Live Contact page includes a 250-character message counter and reCAPTCHA area. No matching local contact page/state was captured.
candidates.scopeNote: No contact submitted; CAPTCHA verification and message delivery are out of scope.

candidates.observation: Both were captured at 390×844. The PageRouter mobile shell retains its top project bar, long tabs, framing controls and embedded leaf; the iframe is 354×680, while desktop is 1124×720. Therefore embedded local content has less available area than the live full page, and live mobile navigation/cards use a different responsive composition.
candidates.scopeNote: This describes the current composed viewport; whether iframe behavior is intended is a product decision.

candidates.observation: Reference requests Inter and Fraunces from Google Fonts plus its transparent logo and homepage/partner imagery. Local screenshot uses its local logo and visibly different visual system. Local browser evidence does not establish loading the same font files or imagery.
candidates.scopeNote: A matching visual appearance does not require copying remote binary assets; source and licensing choices are not assessed.

unknowns: Authenticated Forum, Validation, My Page, and Logout screens/routes are not observed; parity target is the full discoverable public frontend, but role-gated UI specifics remain unknown.
